# 100.00 USD arriving against two CAD splits.
#
# The shape a payment naming several splits cannot divide. Each split
# carries a CAD figure that stood in for the receivable — 70.00 and 69.00 of
# the 139.00 the entry is quoted at — and neither is a fact about the
# settlement.
#
# One such split can be restated from what the bank received. Two cannot:
# dividing the 100.00 USD between them needs a ratio, and the only numbers on
# offer are the ones being discarded. Splitting it 70/69 because the CAD
# happened to fall that way is a rate invented out of scaffolding.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD transaction, bank +100.00 USD valued
# 139.00 CAD against two `Assets:Due From Director` splits of −70.00 and
# −69.00 CAD, none of them in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-06 * "Money in, parked in two lines"
	guid: "aabbccdd11223344556677889900eeff"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "bbccdd11223344556677889900eeffaa"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.39"
		value: "139.00"
	Assets:Due From Director -70.00 CAD
		guid: "ccdd11223344556677889900eeffaabb"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-70.00"
	Assets:Due From Director -69.00 CAD
		guid: "dd11223344556677889900eeffaabbcc"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-69.00"
